Class Game

java.lang.Object
Game
public class Game extends Object
Controls the Candy Courier game and coordinates the player's activities and rank-based upgrades.

      public void handleViewInventory()

    • handleTravel

      public void handleTravel()
      Displays the available travel directions and allows the player to move around the world. Diagonal movement is only available at 3 stars or higher. Arriving at a factory or house triggers its respective event.

    • handleFactory

      public void handleFactory(Factory factory)
      Displays the factory menu and allows the player to pick up candies or exit the factory.
      Parameters:
      factory - the factory the player has entered
